requirements.text: The portal should provide guidance for patients when booking appointments to ensure they choose the right options.
The system should have a feature to flag urgent cases for immediate attention.
Appointment reminders should be sent to patients to help them remember their scheduled visits.
There should be a clear contact option, like a phone number or chat feature, for patients to reach out for assistance.
Easy-to-find FAQs or guides should be available to help patients navigate the portal.
